hero_desc_zh: 圣辉圣骑士形态：天使板甲与流光巨剑，背后展开由发光光丝构成的羽翼，周身环绕金色晨曦光辉，以圣光爆发与巨剑弧光为武器
casual_opening_zh: 圣地中的寻常一刻——缓步走过古老神殿的静谧殿廊
casual_opening_en: an ordinary moment in a sacred place — walking the quiet halls of an ancient temple

opponent.desc_zh: 身披猩红与银白抛光铠甲的骑士，甲缝间渗出猩红能量
opponent.desc_en: knight in polished crimson-and-silver plate, scarlet energy seeping from the seams

environment.desc_en: storm-wracked highland plateau, lightning splitting the sky, rain-lashed stone
environment.desc_zh: 雷暴肆虐的高原，闪电撕裂天空，暴雨抽打嶙峋岩石
